title: Error Handling
theory:
> **Curriculum:** This chapter follows [LEARN-LANGUAGES/CURRICULUM.md](../../CURRICULUM.md). Exercise ids are shared across LEARN-* repos for cross-reference.

## Errors

Use exceptions for exceptional paths; **`try`/`catch`**, custom exception types, and `when` filters.

exercises.title: Return Error
exercises.description: Define divide(a, b float64) (float64, error). Return error if b==0. Call with divide(10, 0) and handle error.
exercises.starter_code: static double? Divide(double a, double b) => b == 0 ? null : a / b;
hints: if b == 0 { return 0, errors.New("division by zero") }

exercises.title: Error Types
exercises.description: Define custom error type NotFoundError with Unwrap(). Check errors.Is() to handle.
exercises.starter_code: class NotFoundError : Exception { public NotFoundError(string k) : base("not found: " + k) { } }
hints: Need to implement Unwrap() for errors.Is to work

exercises.title: fmt.Errorf Wrapping
exercises.description: Create a function wrapError() that uses fmt.Errorf to wrap an error with context.

exercises.title: errors.As Type Assertion
exercises.description: Create a custom error type ValidationError with a Field string. Use errors.As to extract it.
exercises.starter_code: class ValidationError : Exception { public string Field; public ValidationError(string f) : base("invalid email") => Field = f; }
hints: errors.As(err, &ve) extracts the error into ve

exercises.title: Nil Error
exercises.description: Create a function that returns nil error on success, then check for nil in main.
exercises.starter_code: static int SafeDivide(int a, int b) => a / b;
exercises.solution:
Console.WriteLine(SafeDivide(10, 2));

static int SafeDivide(int a, int b) => a / b;

exercises.title: Multi-Level Error Wrapping
exercises.description: Create a function readFile that wraps an errors.New("disk full") with context. Then in main, unwrap and check if it wraps the original error using errors.Is.
exercises.starter_code: var err = new Exception("reading data.txt: disk full", new Exception("disk full"));
exercises.expected_output:
reading data.txt: disk full
Disk is full
hints: Use %w verb in fmt.Errorf to wrap the underlying error
errors.Is(err, target) checks if err wraps or equals target

exercises.title: Sentinel Errors
exercises.description: Define a sentinel error variable ErrNotFound = errors.New("not found"). Return it from a function and check with errors.Is.
